# Nhost Documentation

> > Comprehensive documentation for Nhost, a Backend-as-a-Service platform built on PostgreSQL, GraphQL, and modern JavaScript frameworks.

Nhost provides developers with authentication, database, storage, and serverless functions. The documentation covers setup guides, framework integrations (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, React Native), API references, CLI commands, and deployment options including self-hosting.

## Key Topics

- Nhost Backend-as-a-Service
- GraphQL API
- PostgreSQL Database
- React Integration
- Next.js Framework
- Authentication & Auth
- Nhost CLI
- Local Development
- Self-Hosting
- JavaScript/TypeScript
- Full-Stack Development
- API Reference
- Database Performance
- Docker Compose

## Getting Started

- [Welcome | Nhost Documentation](https://docs.nhost.io): Nhost documentation homepage with quick links to guides and API reference
- [What is Nhost? | Nhost Documentation](https://docs.nhost.io/getting-started): Nhost introduction: BaaS platform overview and quickstart links

## Framework Tutorials

- [Create Your Nhost Project (Next.js) | Nhost Documentation](https://docs.nhost.io/getting-started/tutorials/nextjs/1-introduction): Next.js tutorial series introduction: setup Nhost project for full-stack dev
- [Create Your Nhost Project (React) | Nhost Documentation](https://docs.nhost.io/getting-started/tutorials/react/1-introduction): React tutorial series introduction: setup Nhost backend and authentication
- [Create Your Nhost Project (Vue) | Nhost Documentation](https://docs.nhost.io/getting-started/tutorials/vue/1-introduction): Vue tutorial series: setup Nhost project with GraphQL and authentication
- [Create Your Nhost Project (Svelte) | Nhost Documentation](https://docs.nhost.io/getting-started/tutorials/svelte/1-introduction): SvelteKit tutorial series introduction: setup Nhost backend project
- [Create Your Nhost Project (React Native) | Nhost Documentation](https://docs.nhost.io/getting-started/tutorials/reactnative/1-introduction): React Native tutorial series: setup Nhost project for mobile development

## API Reference & CLI

- [Overview | Nhost Documentation](https://docs.nhost.io/reference): API reference overview for Nhost backend services and client libraries
- [Nhost CLI Reference | Nhost Documentation](https://docs.nhost.io/reference/cli/commands): Complete Nhost CLI command reference with options and configuration

- [Local Development | Nhost Documentation](https://docs.nhost.io/platform/cli/local-development): Setup local Nhost dev environment with Docker and PostgreSQL

## Deployment & Self-Hosting
